records.Learner_Question: A gas sample has a mass of 6.00 g and occupies 3.08 dm³ at 1.20 atm and 300 K. Using R = 0.0821 atm dm³ K⁻¹ mol⁻¹, calculate its molar mass.
records.Model_Answer: Use M = mRT/(PV) (or first calculate n = PV/RT and then M = m/n). Substitution gives M = (6.00 × 0.0821 × 300)/(1.20 × 3.08). The molar mass is approximately 40.0 g mol⁻¹.
